output.brief: The crash gap is mainly coming from build 7.4.0, not from the Tiled Canvas flag. 7.4.0 crashes at about 2% of sessions versus 0.7% on 7.3.2, and the gap was already there on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramp started. The top 7.4.0 crash is a native crash in the Pixelda 3.1 image library (HEIF decoding), which does not appear in 7.3.2. The app store's own console independently shows the same rates, so this is not just a reporting artifact from the new crash SDK. Within 7.4.0, flagged and unflagged users crash at nearly the same rate (2.10% vs 1.98%, interval includes zero), so the flag does not explain much. Turning the flag off and shipping 7.4.0 to everyone would not fix the crash and would spread it. I'm fairly confident in this, though the Pixelda crash stacks don't show which screen triggers it. Next: hold the 7.4.0 rollout at 25%, keep the flag and crash SDK as they are, and get a fix build for the Pixelda decode crash. Let the existing holdout keep measuring the flag's small effect.
